profile.summary: simonbrunel is a Mid-level JavaScript reviewer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, focusing primarily on frontend visualization and UI-related improvements. Their reviews demonstrate strong functional programming patterns (immutability, pure functions) and object-oriented design principles, particularly in the context of data visualization. While they show awareness of testing and documentation practices, their experience is limited to basic testing knowledge and lacks hands-on implementation. The reviewer has no visible exposure to modern frontend frameworks (React, Vue, Angular) or backend JavaScript (Node.js). Their contributions are primarily focused on frontend rendering, UI fixes, and documentation updates within the Chart.js ecosystem, with minimal involvement in broader JavaScript development practices like build tools, TypeScript, or advanced asynchronous programming.
